eventShapes.cue: three-prong ground marker plus equipment silhouette; one restrained spawn onset
eventShapes.terminalRule: remains active until matched supply pickup, replacement, expiry or authoritative resync removal

eventShapes.cue: none from the supply adapter; ordinary equipment presentation owns this legal flat event
eventShapes.terminalRule: not tracked by supply lifecycle adapter

eventShapes.cue: inward bracket closes around held-slot icon; world marker removed only after authoritative event/snapshot
eventShapes.terminalRule: with a ready bounded active supply ledger, terminate exactly one uniquely matched active supply; no active match bypasses with no cue or marker change; definition conflict or multiple active matches fail closed

eventShapes.cue: broken-ring recycle notch on old held slot; no world drop
eventShapes.terminalRule: require one matching active supply identity, then hold at most one pending pair for it until the immediately paired EquipmentReplaced identity validates; no active match fails closed

eventShapes.cue: exchange-arrow closes from old slot to new slot; paired with preceding recycle identity
eventShapes.terminalRule: require one matching active supply identity and pending recycle pair; paired Replaced terminates target marker once, clears pending and never waits for EquipmentPickedUp; no active match fails closed

eventShapes.cue: notched perimeter collapses to a stable crossed-hourglass endpoint; no lingering rescue frame
eventShapes.terminalRule: require and terminate exactly one matched active supply at expireTick; no active match, definition conflict or multiple match fails closed

routingRules.adapterReadinessRule: before processing any event, require gap-free history or an eventSequence-bound complete active supply lifecycle projection; otherwise enter resync and process nothing
routingRules.supplySpawnPredicate: EquipmentSpawned has exactly the common envelope plus payload, no flat equipment fields, and strict payload identity validates
routingRules.ordinarySpawnBypassPredicate: EquipmentSpawned has exactly the common envelope plus flat equipmentInstanceId/equipmentDefinitionId/spawnId/position and no payload
routingRules.ambiguousSpawnRule: payload mixed with any flat spawned field, neither legal shape, or malformed strict payload fails closed and creates no marker
routingRules.activeSupplyPickupRule: with a ready bounded active ledger, EquipmentPickedUp terminates only the single active supply whose equipmentInstanceId and equipmentDefinitionId both match
routingRules.ordinaryPickupBypassRule: with a ready bounded active ledger, a legal flat EquipmentPickedUp matching no active supply bypasses, emits no supply cue and changes no supply marker
routingRules.pickupConflictRule: an equipmentInstanceId active match with definition mismatch or more than one active match removes no marker and requests authoritative resync
routingRules.replacementTerminalRule: a contiguous identity-matched EquipmentRecycled then EquipmentReplaced pair terminates the target supply; EquipmentPickedUp is neither awaited nor consumed for replacement
routingRules.strictTerminalMatchRule: EquipmentRecycled, EquipmentReplaced and EquipmentExpired must each match exactly one active supply identity; no match or conflicting match fails closed

resilience.duplicate: keep one lastAppliedSequence waterline plus a 64-entry recent canonical hash ring; sequence at or below waterline and present with identical hash is ignored, while conflicting hash fails closed
resilience.outOfOrder: next sequence must equal lastAppliedSequence plus one; a forward gap enters resync, while an event older than the 64-entry ring is never applied and never replays a one-shot
resilience.disconnectRecovery: require gap-free history or an eventSequence-bound complete active supply lifecycle projection before processing any event; otherwise the entire adapter enters resync, processes nothing and hides countdown
resilience.pauseResume: frozen authority tick freezes all persistent progress; no wall-clock catch-up
resilience.replay: seek or reset creates a new projection epoch, clears the recent hash ring and pending replacement pairs, restores bounded active identities, and never reuses dedupe state across epochs
resilience.assetFailure: diagnostic geometry plus icon code is accessibility fallback only and fails representative-asset gate
resilience.unknownOrFuture: unknown type, schema, field or missing required field fails closed without best-effort rendering
resilience.destroy: idempotently clear active identities, lastAppliedSequence, recent hash ring, pending replacement pairs, current projection epoch, markers, particles, audio voices, listeners and pooled references

accessibility.reducedMotion: replace expansion, collapse and travel with stable edge, notch and state swap at the same authority tick
accessibility.silent: every supply cue retains shape, icon and short text/state announcement; no countdown audio loop
accessibility.colorVision: red-green and blue-purple distinctions always retain different shape plus texture/icon
accessibility.screenReader: announce spawn count once, replacement result once, and expiry once; never announce each countdown tick

formalRepresentativeInputs: A0.3 human blind test coordinator approval with at least 10 qualified people
approved gap-free event history or eventSequence-bound complete active supply lifecycle projection
approved representative equipment silhouette/icon and provenance
approved temporary VFX/audio source manifests with license and hashes
approved measurement plan, budget thresholds and capture method for GPU, overdraw, memory, voice and lifecycle

score.basis: A1.0 contract completeness only; no asset, device, runtime integration or human maturity
